subject: here's where we're up to with the refactoring

messages.author: 990bd78abe1370d4
messages.subject: here's where we're up to with the refactoring
parts:
Hi!

Here's where we've got to:

We've been simplifying the structure of the decision tree growing and again applying appropriate design patterns and class design.  This has been quite a lot of work and it's not quite finished yet.

We're going to continue with that, begin testing gbm under UBSAN so that we can be as sure as we can be that we aren't triggering undefined behaviour, and introduce unit tests for the tree growing code.  After we've done that, the next step is to replace the coxph code with that provided by Terry T.

Any feedback or suggestions are welcome, and progress may be viewed at

https://github.com/scientific-computing-solutions/gbm

Best wishes,

--
pdm
